brief: Clear the bird nesting material packed into the upper ventilation grille in accordance with SOP-011 and SOP-015, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity before a forecast heat event. Address the radiator bank scale build-up and the cooling stage cycling intermittently, noting that no procedure covers these specific cooling defects. Account for the unit's 42-year age and insulation ageing risks per MG-023 during heat exposure.
